title: Restricting a point of a groupoid scheme over a field to an algebraically closed extension

statement_spans.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-groupoid-on-field-explain-points (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 1257-1273

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: For a groupoid scheme (U, R, s, t, c) over a field k with U = Spec(k), every point r of R becomes, after restriction to a suitable algebraically closed field extension k'/k, a point r' whose source and target maps are isomorphisms k' to kappa(r'). The proof is a three-step field construction: pick an algebraically closed k' of very large transcendence degree, embed kappa(r) into k' over k via a transcendence basis, then build an automorphism tau of k' carrying the target embedding to the source embedding, giving the diagram the restriction requires (source lines 1275-1326)

core_obligations: Exhibit the field diagram the geometric statement translates to: embeddings i : k -> k', sigma : kappa(r) -> k' with sigma composed with s equal to i, and an automorphism tau : k' -> k' with tau composed with i equal to sigma composed with t (proof lines 1276-1288).
Step 1: pick i : k -> k' with k' algebraically closed of very large transcendence degree over k (proof lines 1290-1291).
Step 2: construct sigma : kappa(r) -> k' with sigma s = i by mapping a transcendence basis of kappa(r) over k to algebraically independent elements of k' and extending (proof lines 1292-1300).

Step 3: construct tau : k' -> k' with tau i = sigma t by extending the isomorphism sigma t i^{-1} : i(k) -> sigma(t(k)) to their algebraic closures in k', matching the residual transcendence bases by cardinality, and closing to an automorphism of k' (proof lines 1301-1323).
Conclude that the restriction of (U, R, s, t, c) via Spec(k') -> Spec(k) carries the point r' over r with s', t' inducing isomorphisms k' -> kappa(r') (proof line 1325).
proof_roadmap: Translate the groupoid point statement into the field diagram with i, sigma, tau (proof lines 1276-1288).
Build sigma over a transcendence basis (proof lines 1292-1300).
Build tau by closure extension and basis cardinality (proof lines 1301-1323).
